quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical H1 2026 revenue RMB 2,827,938,748.37, up 15.15% (H1 2025: RMB 2,455,890,299.50); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,204,285,104.14, up 33.92%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,186,263,481.07, up 36.76%; cost of sales down 8.44%; operating cash flow RMB 1,000,881,668.42, up 64.57%. The company attributes the growth to AI and global data-center and AI supercomputing build-outs driving steady growth in demand for high-speed optical devices, and says a periodic supply shortage of individual materials limited its growth in the period; FX losses were RMB 8,584.65 ten-thousand.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical H1 2026 revenue by product: passive optical devices RMB 1,530,364,516.33, up 77.40%, gross margin 71.90% (up 8.33 pt); active optical devices RMB 1,259,923,042.78, down 19.57%, gross margin 47.03% (up 3.67 pt). Optical interconnect components overall gross margin 60.67% (H1 2025: 50.54%). The company says the shortage of individual materials had a large impact on ramping output of its active optical devices. Sales to Asia excluding China RMB 1,595,122,181.17, to North America RMB 30,663,808.15.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical H1 2026 optical interconnect components: capacity 3.4023 hundred million units (H1 2025: 2.9800), output 2.5766 hundred million (2.0975), sales volume 1.3530 hundred million (1.2707; up 6.48%); capacity and output include units used internally. In H1 2026 both passive and active optical device lines at the Thailand base were ramping steadily and the Jiangxi base phase 2 production building was delivered and put into use. The company says some industry materials stayed tight with marked price swings, and it applied targeted controls on bottleneck materials to protect delivery; inventory rose to RMB 928,830,690.11 at June 30 from RMB 457,195,929.70 at the start of the year.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical (half-year report) now describes itself as a one-stop optical interconnect provider of passive devices, active devices and optical module contract manufacturing services. Its customers cover leading global optical module makers and it has deep cooperation with leading global AI computing infrastructure vendors (names not given); average cooperation with its main customers exceeds ten years. Citing Frost & Sullivan research, the company says it was the first supplier worldwide to deliver 800G and 1.6T optical engines and is a core partner for a leading global AI computing infrastructure vendor's CPO solution.
